mentions.name: Visor
mentions.description: Visor is a trading terminal centered around options and gamma exposure (GEX). Its main feature overlays the options payout graph directly onto the live price chart, letting users watch options Greeks play out in real time. The author reports it has been instrumental in deeply understanding the dynamics of more advanced options trades.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Visor. It’s a new type of trading terminal centered around options and gex. The main feature is overlaying the options payout graph right on the chart.

Think tastytrade rotated 90° and put on your live barchart and then watching all the Greeks play out in real time.
mentions.author: GageBachik
